decision.explanation: The sources provide multiple overlapping yet distinct occupational roles for Daniel Caraminot. Document d1 describes him as a 'former French politician' who transitioned to a pensioner after a political career. Document d2 confirms his identity as a 'French politician' and adds that he worked as an 'agricultural consultant,' was 'President of the French Association of Anciens Agriculteurs Exploitants,' and was an 'advocate for ancients agriculteurs exploitants.' These roles are not mutually exclusive and represent different phases or aspects of his professional life. All claims are directly supported by the source texts and do not conflict with each other under the same referent.
